title: weather (widget tool input)
description: What the agent sends to the widget tool: the payload without id, rev and producer (the tool sets them); fallback_text optional (the tool writes it); from_file allowed. The weather for one place: now, the next hours with the chance of rain, the days ahead on a shared range scale, and one plain-language tip.

name.description: The place as people say it: New York, Lisbon, “Home”.

current.description: It’s the device’s current location: VoiceOver says so, and the default header glyph is the location arrow (location.fill) instead of a pin.

unit.description: The temperature unit every temperature is in. The client shows ° alone and VoiceOver says the unit. Required: 14 means nothing without it.

temp.description: Degrees in `unit`. null when unknown: shown as —, never 0.

feels.description: Feels like, in `unit`. null when unknown: shown as —, never 0.

high.description: Today’s high. null when unknown: shown as —, never 0.

low.description: Today’s low. null when unknown: shown as —, never 0.

condition.description: The condition. The client draws its SF Symbol (monochrome; only precipitation glyphs are blue) and says it in words in the reader’s language. Omit when unknown: the glyph slot shows —.

label.description: The condition in words when the default isn’t right: “Light rain, clearing”.

night.description: Draw the night glyph (moon) for clear and partly cloudy skies.

precip_chance.description: Chance of precipitation, 0–1 (0.7 = 70%). Shown in blue under the glyph from 0.3 up; lower chances stay quiet. Omit when unknown, never 0.

now.description: Conditions now: the big temperature, the condition and feels-like, and today’s high and low trailing.

at.description: The hour. Shown in the place’s own offset (“16”), the first as “Now” when it’s the current hour.

temp.description: Degrees in `unit`. null when unknown: shown as —, never 0.

condition.description: The condition. The client draws its SF Symbol (monochrome; only precipitation glyphs are blue) and says it in words in the reader’s language. Omit when unknown: the glyph slot shows —.

precip_chance.description: Chance of precipitation, 0–1 (0.7 = 70%). Shown in blue under the glyph from 0.3 up; lower chances stay quiet. Omit when unknown, never 0.

hours.description: The next hours, in order. The client shows as many as fit and scrolls the rest sideways.

date.description: The day, in the place’s calendar. “Today”, then short weekday names.

low.description: Degrees in `unit`. null when unknown: shown as —, never 0.

high.description: Degrees in `unit`. null when unknown: shown as —, never 0.

condition.description: The condition. The client draws its SF Symbol (monochrome; only precipitation glyphs are blue) and says it in words in the reader’s language. Omit when unknown: the glyph slot shows —.

precip_chance.description: Chance of precipitation, 0–1 (0.7 = 70%). Shown in blue under the glyph from 0.3 up; lower chances stay quiet. Omit when unknown, never 0.

items.description: One day: low, a range bar, high.

days.description: The days ahead, starting today or the first day of a trip.

text.description: One line that turns the forecast into a decision: “Rain from 4 PM. Take an umbrella for the walk home.”

tip.description: The tip. Its glyph is blue only when it’s about precipitation (umbrella, raindrop).

severity.description: The state colour, glyph and word of the banner.

title.description: As issued, in plain words: “Yellow warning: thunderstorms”.

issuer.description: Who issued it: Environment Canada, Met Office, National Weather Service.

alerts.description: Official warnings, most severe first. The first is the banner; more show as “+1 more”.

layout.description: auto: now and hours when sent, days under them. compact: one line: the glyph, now’s temperature (or the first day’s high), then the first alert with its state glyph when there is one, otherwise the tip.
